glioma.selection: Practical authorized direct-download choice; not a claim of largest available cohort
glioma.citation: Antonelli et al. The Medical Segmentation Decathlon. Nature Communications 13, 4128 (2022). doi:10.1038/s41467-022-30695-9; cite BraTS source publications too.
glioma.count_note: 750 4D case volumes, not 3,000 patients. Unique clinical patient identity not independently established. BraTS 2016/17 overlap; do not pool as independent cohorts.
glioma.download_probe: 200 HEAD, Content-Length 7608266240, Accept-Ranges bytes; official MONAI 1.5.1 MD5 verified; payload not fetched.
limitations: 7.61 GB archive (7.09 GiB), confirmed by HEAD; extraction needs additional storage. The previous notebook 2 GB estimate is incorrect.
Training masks only for 484 cases; not all 750.
Already represented in the segmentation project: reuse any existing verified archive in this acquisition destination; do not duplicate under BraTS names.
License must also be confirmed from extracted dataset.json; no clinical approval is implied.

meningioma.selection: Preferred larger anatomically broader author-released 3D cohort; original 37-patient choice retained as an alternative
meningioma.citation: Hwang et al. Fully Automated Segmentation Models of Supratentorial Meningiomas Assisted by Inclusion of Normal Brain Images. Journal of Imaging 8(12), 327 (2022). doi:10.3390/jimaging8120327; dataset doi:10.5281/zenodo.5945963
meningioma.count_note: 91 meningioma patients contribute 171 scans: 115 scans from 35 followed patients plus 56 single-scan patients. Additional lesion-negative lung-cancer subjects: paper body says 10, supplementary Table S1 says 12; total/control counts are unresolved.
meningioma.download_probe: Official author-deposited open Zenodo release and direct HEAD 200 size confirmed; publisher MD5 supplied. MRI archive not downloaded or listed in Cloud.
limitations: One tertiary hospital; 48/91 convexity tumors, 22/91 skull-base attachment, only 3/91 olfactory-groove cases. Broader than ds007345, not population representative.
Published clinical protocol includes four sequences; the exact archive channel/mask inventory must be inspected in Colab. Do not assume every acquired sequence or mask is released.
Paper body uses 10 lesion-negative controls; supplement Table S1 lists 12. These subjects had lung cancer, not population-healthy IXI-like controls.

Published archive filenames/longitudinal ID mapping were not independently established without reading MRI data. Download first into private Drive, inspect headers, then provide an explicit reviewed file-to-patient/diagnosis/visit CSV. No scan IDs are invented as patient IDs.

With no reviewed map the notebook produces a file inventory and a blank mapping template, reports download verified / mapping pending, and does not claim a verified patient-level manifest or training readiness.
The article data-availability statement has a 10.5271 DOI typo; use verified Zenodo DOI prefix 10.5281.

openneuro37.selection: Verified ungated structural-MRI alternative to larger controlled-access releases
openneuro37.citation: Filimonova et al. Multimodal Brain MRI and Clinical Data in Olfactory Groove Meningioma: A Prospective Data Report. doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds007345.v1.0.0
openneuro37.download_probe: All 179 selected S3 assets returned HEAD 200 with matching byte sizes and Range support. Every publisher SHA256E pointer was verified. No MRI payload fetched in Cloud.
limitations: Single center, olfactory groove subtype only; not representative of all meningiomas.
Only baseline structural images and available tumor/edema masks selected; DWI, fMRI, processed diffusion and all postoperative repeats excluded.
T1 run numbers do not reliably establish pre/post contrast; retain contrast_unspecified until source metadata review.
Edema masks are not supplied for every patient; missing is not a healthy label.

brain_metastasis.selection: Author-deposited, ungated latest PROTEAS release; replaces unresolved UCSF transfer
brain_metastasis.citation: Flouri et al. A longitudinal MRI dataset of brain metastases with tumor segmentations, clinical & radiomic data. Scientific Data 12, 1828 (2025). doi:10.1038/s41597-025-06131-0; data doi:10.5281/zenodo.23171182
formats: CT and radiotherapy NIfTI ancillary data
brain_metastasis.download_probe: All 45 patient/course ZIPs and clinical XLSX returned anonymous HEAD 200 with matching sizes; Zenodo publisher MD5 supplied. No MRI payload downloaded.
limitations: Single-center treatment-enriched cohort; pre/post-treatment scans are not independent patients.
45 course archives represent 40 patients. P04/P07/P17/P20/P23 a/b courses share one patient split group; P31/P33 lesion rows in clinical metadata do not create new patients.
Six ZIP MD5s and the clinical spreadsheet changed since 17253793. Never merge old and new release files.
Lesions under 3 mm were excluded by the study. Masks include necrosis=1, enhancing tumor=2, edema=3; tissue labels 10/30/40/50 are not tumor labels.
ZIPs also contain CT, radiotherapy and raw DICOM. MRI manifests use only documented BraTS MRI sequences; other NIfTI data are labeled ancillary. No conversion or model preprocessing runs.
Radiomics XLSX is not needed for acquisition and is not selected.

alzheimers.selection: Official legacy OASIS-2 direct archives, with explicit clinical-group review and weaker integrity disclosure
alzheimers.license: OASIS Data Use Terms (custom; not CC0 or CC BY)
alzheimers.license_summary: Scientific use; no reidentification/contact or facial reconstruction; source-specific acknowledgement/citation; provide Knight ADRC usage information on request. PET-specific Avid review terms do not apply to this T1-only selection.
alzheimers.citation: Marcus et al. Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS): Longitudinal MRI Data in Nondemented and Demented Older Adults. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience 22(12):2677-2684 (2010). doi:10.1162/jocn.2009.21407
formats: NIfTI-1; paired IMG/HDR supported; exact raw packaging inspected in Colab
alzheimers.download_probe: Both official raw archives returned anonymous HEAD 200 and Range support. Authorized maintainer README explicitly says OASIS1/2 download directly; later OASIS releases need signed DUA/project access.
limitations: No publisher cryptographic checksum is available from the official directory or HEAD metadata. HTTPS, exact source size and full gzip CRC32 are verified; local SHA-256 is saved and compared on repeat use. This is weaker than publisher-hash verification and is explicitly reported before download.

The current central website returns 503; access/terms are corroborated by the publisher-maintained NITRC page, official NrgXnat scripts and official Washington University download server, not third-party MRI copies.
Three or four T1 acquisitions per session and repeated visits are not independent patients. Namespaced OAS2 identifiers group every visit/channel together.
Clinical AD diagnosis follows this cohort's published assessment, not an arbitrary dementia or MCI folder label. Do not equate generic CDR 0.5 with AD.

A reviewed per-file clinical-group map is required. The 14 converters must be marked converter_excluded, not mixed into stable control/AD groups. Missing diagnosis remains unknown. The notebook does not fabricate clinical metadata.
Without a reviewed map the download can finish and patient identities can be inventoried, but diagnostic labels remain pending. No binary AD/control training readiness is claimed.
Single-scanner historical research sample; clinical AD is not equivalent to universal biomarker confirmation. No focal lesion masks. Existing IXI is not used or changed.
alzheimers.required_acknowledgement: Data provided [in part] by OASIS. OASIS-2: Longitudinal: Principal Investigators: D. Marcus, R. Buckner, J. Csernansky, J. Morris; P50 AG05681, P01 AG03991, P01 AG026276, R01 AG021910, P20 MH071616, U24 RR021382.

post_stroke.selection: Verified public multi-center annotated stroke alternative; acute lesions, not chronic T1-only ATLAS
post_stroke.citation: Hernandez Petzsche et al. ISLES 2022: A multi-center magnetic resonance imaging stroke lesion segmentation dataset. Scientific Data 9, 762 (2022). doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01875-5; dataset doi:10.5281/zenodo.7153326
post_stroke.download_probe: HEAD 200 with matching 1692717470 byte size. Official open-access Zenodo record and publisher MD5 verified; no payload fetched in Cloud.
limitations: 250 public training cases, not the 400-case full challenge cohort.
Acute/subacute ischemic lesions; not a substitute for chronic post-stroke T1 structural lesions.
FLAIR, DWI and ADC remain in native space; do not assume cross-sequence registration.
No normal/control subjects; IXI differs in modality, age distribution and scanner protocol.
